messages:
olivia: Heads-up — customer acme-inc reporting TLS handshake failures to their Redwood Private endpoint after yesterday's cert rotation. Error: `tls: bad certificate` from client side. Ticket: SUP-8421.

ian: Oof. Any repro steps from their side? IPs, curl output?

olivia: They tried from their app and from CLI. Here's the curl we got from them:
```
curl -v https://api.private.redwood.acme.example.com/healthcheck 
* TLSv1.3 (OUT), TLS handshake, Client hello (1)
* TLSv1.3 (IN), TLS alert, server hello (2)
* error:14094410:SSL routines:ssl3_read_bytes:sslv3 alert certificate unknown
* Closing connection 0
```
They said the error started right after certificate update around 09:15 UTC.

neha: Can we get openssl s_client from their network or run it against the VIP from our side? Want to see the chain.

sam: I ran from our lab node to the VIP (10.12.5.90:443) — output shows only the leaf cert present, intermediate missing. Snip: 
```
$ echo | openssl s_client -servername api.private.redwood.acme.example.com -connect 10.12.5.90:443 -showcerts
CONNECTED(00000003)
depth=0 CN = api.private.redwood.acme.example.com
verify error:num=20:unable to get local issuer certificate
---
Certificate chain
 0 s:/CN=api.private.redwood.acme.example.com
   i:/CN=Acme Intermediate CA
---
-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
...LEAF...
-----END CERTIFICATE-----
```
No intermediate block after the leaf in the response.

maya: That matches "certificate unknown" behavior. Likely the rotation script uploaded only the leaf cert and omitted the intermediate bundle. Did they use the new automated rotation or manual?

olivia: Customer used the automated rotation. They provided the rotation job log: `upload_cert_bundle --file cert.pem` — but the file they pointed to only had the leaf.

ian: Steps to triage: 1) confirm cert files on the ingress node, 2) check nginx/traefik (whatever is serving) config for `ssl_certificate` vs `ssl_certificate_chain`, 3) re-upload bundle containing leaf + intermediate, 4) reload the ingress.

neha: I'm on it — grabbing the ingress node and checking `/etc/ssl/redwood/` now.

infra-bot: [auto] Created escalation SUP-8421 -> ENG-PLATFORM. Assigned: sam, eta 4h.

neha: Found `/etc/ssl/redwood/api_cert.pem` — it only contains the leaf. The intermediate is missing. Also found `rotation.log` with this line: `wrote /etc/ssl/redwood/api_cert.pem (leaf only)` — looks like rotation script failed to concatenate intermediate.

sam: Thanks. Short-term fix: assemble full chain and update. Please create `fullchain.pem` with leaf then intermediate(s) and run `sudo mv fullchain.pem /etc/ssl/redwood/api_fullchain.pem && sudo systemctl reload redwood-ingress`.

neha: Applied fix, reloaded ingress at 10:42 UTC. Ran `openssl s_client -connect 10.12.5.90:443 -servername api.private.redwood.acme.example.com -showcerts` again — now shows leaf + intermediate and verify passed (no verify error).

olivia: Customer confirmed from their side that app connections are succeeding again after their local caches cleared. They reported success at 10:55 UTC.

maya: Need to ship a patch to the rotation script so it validates bundle contents (must contain at least one intermediate) before upload, and fail-safe to keep previous cert if new bundle is invalid.

ian: Filed PR draft: add validation + test harness to ci. Also will add a post-rotation check that runs `openssl verify` against the served endpoint and alerts if chain incomplete.

olivia: Customer happy for now. Action items: neha to write incident blurb for postmortem, sam to coordinate rotation script fix PR, eng-platform to add monitoring alert for certificate chain changes.

neha: I'll drop a short blurb in postmortems/ and ping accounts team.

sam: Reassigning SUP-8421 to ENG-PLATFORM. Closing support loop. :white_check_mark:
